# NetworkRef

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A network location test (#38). Address tests match when any local
interface address does.

Appears at: `/policy/location_profiles/all`, `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/network/exclude`, `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/network/include`, `/policy/scope/network/exclude`, `/policy/scope/network/include`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/network/exclude`, and more.

## Variants

### `cidr`

An address block, such as `10.20.0.0/16` or `2001:db8::/32`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cidr` | string | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |

### `range`

An inclusive address range, such as `10.0.0.10-10.0.0.99`.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `range` | string | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |

A connection-specific DNS suffix, such as `corp.example.org`. Also
